name: Hard Sample Mining for NeRF Optimization
definition: A method to optimize Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) by identifying and backpropagating gradients only for 'hard' samples (those contributing significantly to loss), while skipping the expensive backward pass for 'easy' samples to save compute and memory.
summary: Hard Sample Mining for NeRF Optimization accelerates training by backpropagating gradients only for hard samples using a two-forward-one-backward pass structure.
